commons_title: File:Portrait photograph of Mustafa Kemal in military uniform 1930.jpg
author: SKS News
description_short: Portrait photograph of Mustafa Kemal in military uniform, probably in 1930
notes: Sharp studio bust portrait in military uniform (1930), dark plain background, face upper-centre looking left; right shoulder runs off the frame edge.

commons_title: File:Atatürk as a alumni of Ottoman Military Academy, 1905.jpg
author: Unknown author
description_short: Atatürk as a alumni of Ottoman Military Academy, 11 January 1905
notes: Full-length standing portrait as young Staff Captain (Kurmay Yuzbasi) 1905, fez touches top edge and feet touch bottom; halftone/print texture, soft but clean.

author: Unknown author
description_short: Mustafa Kemal Bey in the Gallipoli front
notes: Iconic Gallipoli 1915 full-length field photo on a wooded slope; low resolution (784x1010) and sepia newsprint grain, upscales soft.

commons_title: File:Mustapha Kemal Pasha & members of his Nationalist Committee, Sivas, 1919.jpg
author: Unknown author
description_short: Group of Turkish officials at Sivas, Turkey, Sept. 21, 1919...
notes: Sivas Congress delegation group photo (Sept 1919), Mustafa Kemal seated front-row centre; sharp, wide; archive number scratched bottom-left and blown-out ground at bottom.

commons_title: File:Prayers in the front of BMM large.jpg
author: Unknown author
description_short: Prayers in front of BMM, Ankara, 1920.
notes: Deputies praying in front of the First Assembly building before the opening, 23 April 1920; small (828x449) and soft; identification of Mustafa Kemal in the front line is approximate - treat as scene shot, not a cut-out.

commons_title: File:Mustafa Kemal Pasha in the Turkish Grand National Assembly, 1 March 1921.jpg
author: Esad Nedim
description_short: Turkish Grand National Assembly, Mustafa Kemal Pasha, addresses the deputies at the first assembly meeting, during the second legislative period (Tuesday, March 1, 1921)
notes: Large interior of the First Assembly hall (1 Mar 1921), Mustafa Kemal backlit at the rostrum upper-right; heavy scratches and light flare on right side; good for slow pan, poor for cut-out.

commons_title: File:Atatürk in Kocatepe before the start of the Great Offensive, August 30, 1922.jpg
author: Etem Tem
license: Public domain (PD-Ottoman Empire, PD-TR, PD-Turkey, PD-US-expired, PD-old)
description_short: Mustafa Kemal Pasha in the morning before the start of the Great Offensive
notes: Famous Kocatepe photo (Great Offensive, Aug 1922): kalpak, striding uphill in profile; brown Ottoman-script handwriting overlaid on left and across body; halftone print; legs cropped at bottom.

author: Photographer is unknown
description_short: The first President of the Republic of Turkey Mustafa Kemal Atatürk in a top hat and white tie.
notes: Sharp full-length 1925 portrait in white tie and top hat, standing by a window; excellent quality; negative number '377' at top-right corner (crop it).

author: Unknown author
description_short: Omschrijving: Schrifthervormingen. De Turkse leider Ataturk (Atatürk, Mustafa Kemal Pascha, 1881-1938) voerde in 1928 de hervorming door van het schrift in Turkije. Het Arabische schrift werd door het
notes: Alphabet reform 1928: Ataturk pointing at blackboard with new letters, flags behind; high-contrast halftone press print; box includes extended pointing arm; other people partly behind him.

author: Agence de presse Meurisse. Agence photographique (commanditaire)
